notes:
Checked the complete 35,362-character markdown and the saved 12-page PDF (printed pp. 179-190), including all references and the final page. There is no data/code/materials availability statement, repository link, preregistration, on-request offer, acknowledgement of a deposit, or supplementary-file reference for S1. The statements list preserves the relevant data-collection/export text and the potentially misleading appendix mention, with explanatory locators; none promises access.

The Appendix of Algorithmic Contribution in Table 4 is a proposed student deliverable in a classroom framework, not an appendix or public data file belonging to the study. The bibliography stops at Bose# on printed p. 190. The current publisher PDF returned HTTP 200, contained 603,856 bytes, and its SHA-256 matched the saved PDF byte for byte. No continuation or separate appendix is provided by the article landing page.

forms/c480.json data_and_code has empty data_url and code_url strings. The DOI https://doi.org/10.62788/iccmets2026-paper18 resolves to https://iccmets.com/proceedings/2026/paper-18.html (HTTP 200). Its only document download is paper-18.pdf; the other anchors are the proceedings index and previous/next papers. No supplementary data, code, materials, repository, or preregistration link is present. The article PDF itself contains aggregate tables and selected interview/prompt quotations, not a reusable participant-level deposit, so it is not counted in deposits.

DataCite, Zenodo, Harvard Dataverse and OSF were searched by the complete title, the shorter title phrase Generative AI and Student Creativity, the author in both unaccented and source spelling, and the distinctive phrase Cognitive Anchor-Rebound. All title/phrase searches returned zero results. All result pages for both author-name spellings were retrieved and screened: DataCite 217 and 62 results; Zenodo 54 and 57; Harvard Dataverse 3 and 0; OSF node-title queries 0 and 0. The nonzero results concern unrelated work and names such as Nguyen Thi Mai Huong, Nguyen Thi Mai Phuong, and Nguyen Thi Mai Anh. Potentially ambiguous records were checked using their metadata: SWEAT is software workload data/code; Table 4 (Zenodo 22751844) has a different multi-author team; Reintegrating Northern Delta Cultural Identity concerns primary art education with different authors. None was linked to this paper or its randomized study.

OSF filter[title] searches only project titles, so the author-name queries were supplemented with OSF users filter[full_name] searches. The unaccented query returned one differently named profile, Nguyen Thi Mai Han (zft5p), with no listed affiliation; the accented query returned zero. Neither establishes this paper's author or a relevant deposit.

The 22 distinct repository/profile searches succeeded with HTTP 200. Search n_results values are API totals, not counts of relevant deposits. Pagination is consolidated per query. Zenodo initially rejected size=100 with HTTP 400; its stated public limit size=25 was used successfully without authentication. The publisher search n_results=0 means zero supplementary files, not zero page hyperlinks.

The three DOI URLs printed in the bibliography are citations to other papers, not data deposits: 10.61969/jai.1337146 returned 404; 10.1145/3442188.3445922 and 10.1080/14703297.2023.2190148 redirected to publisher bot checks and returned 403. No bypass was attempted. The first citation's PDF annotation wraps its DOI in a Google search URL; no general web search was performed, and the literal DOI printed in the paper was checked directly instead.

No relevant deposit was identified, so there were no relevant repository file inventories or participant-data columns/rows to inspect. No participant data were downloaded and no code was executed from a deposit. No account was created, login used, access requested, or author contacted.

what_we_could_compute is null because no public participant/output data or analysis code were found. The searches do not supply the raw scores, arm linkage, participant flow, tasks, texts, embeddings, or prompt logs needed to audit per-person means/SDs/SEs and analyzed counts, resolve the fluency/originality and regression discrepancies in final.open_items, or recompute semantic diversity and recurring-theme denominators/uncertainty. No missing statistic was inferred or recomputed from the printed aggregate tables.

Confidence is high for the recorded none_found result in the paper, publisher page and searched public indexes; it is not proof that an unindexed, differently named, private or future deposit does not exist.
